PROBABILITY_YES: 33
REASON: All three main TV polls on 23 October had Yashar 2-3 seats ahead of Likud, and 25 of 41 polls since late September showed Yashar leading. Likud led in only 14, all from Channel 14 or i24NEWS, which are outliers. Likud has a record of beating its mainstream polls (it won 32 seats in 2022 against final polls of 30-31), and its voters are firmer in their choice. A 2-3 seat gap with a few days left is well within polling error, so Likud has a real chance but remains the underdog.
